title: Total influence and singleton Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a monotone Boolean function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$. Its total influence equals the sum of its Fourier coefficients indexed by singleton coordinate sets: $\\operatorname{Inf}_{\\mathrm{tot}}(f)=\\sum_{i=1}^n \\widehat f(\\{i\\})$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
